records.title: Pathforge (code, rules, Canvas/CSS graphics, thumbnail)
records.evidence: Written from scratch for this project. No third-party code, art, fonts or audio. Rules are an original cell-blocking design; the reference game was used for genre inspiration only.

records.title: Neon Dodge (code and Canvas-generated graphics, thumbnail)
records.evidence: Written from scratch for this project. All graphics are drawn at runtime with the Canvas API.

records.title: Chroma Shift (code, level generator, CSS graphics, thumbnail)
records.evidence: Written from scratch for this project. Levels are generated procedurally from a seeded random generator.

records.title: Website templates, CSS, icons and logo mark
records.evidence: Original templates and inline SVG. Uses the visitor's system fonts, so no web fonts are downloaded or licensed.
